results.title: Acquire.com Review 2026: Pricing, Fees & What $100K Costs
results.snippet: Short answer on what Acquire.com costs sellers in 2026: nothing upfront, but you pay a $25–$100/month listing fee while your business is live plus a 6–8% closing fee on a successful sale (8% under $250K, 7% up to $1M, 6% above $1M).
